findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
Observed scoops in the dry mixes with handles touching the food.
3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS 
Fill containers leaving enough space to include scoops without placing the handles of scoops into the food.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: Observed a plastic cup of dog treats suspended above the cooler used for ice.  Move the dog treats to protect food and single service items from potential contamination. 750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed masking tape on many surfaces in the facility. Tape is not an easily clean able surface. Avoid using tape and remove as much as possible. Find clean able options for items such as: 1) marker for whole or non fat milk  2) cleaning brush fixed with tape 3) coffee pot parts held together with tape. 750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily clean able

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Observed the side of the ice machine wall (inside) to be soiled. Knife strip is also soiled with dust. Clean and maintain clean. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use and any time they may have become contaminated.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Drain line from ice machine runs on the floor and is soiled. Clean and maintain clean. 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.
